"If [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] is defending a battle alone at a site, add 1 to power and add one battle destiny. OR If any other Imperial with ability &gt; 2 is defending a battle alone at a site, add one battle destiny."

This Lost Interrupt is great for that surprise Destiny draw for the Dark Side. It is obviously great with [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]], giving an extra Battle Desinty but is good for a long list of other Imperials with ability &gt; 2 to give a little surprise to an unsuspecting [[Han Solo]] and [[Rebel Trooper]]. [[Captain Piett]], [[General Veers]], [[Captain Needa]], [[Commander Brandei]], [[Lieutenant Commander Ardan]] (okay so he already gets a destiny), [[Admiral Motti]], [[General Tagge]], [[Grand Moff Tarkin]] are all valid Imperials. And some of them are probably already in your deck. Add one or two [[Vader's Eye]] for a nasty surprise.

Combo:

Any Imperial with ability &gt; 2 + [[Vader's Cape]] + [[Vader's Eye]] = A mini-[[Darth Vader]]
